t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They said to pick the purple, yellow, and pink colored gnomes and then to switch it up when the colors stop yielding as many mushrooms. But the screen text was cut off so I couldn't fully read what they said.

vb_textbox.text: Personally, I didn't find that picking by colors was all that helpful. It was a bit hard to keep track of, too. What I did was pick a side - either the s side or the k side, and stick to it for a while. If it started to consistently give lower values, I would switch sides. Also, make sure to check if the points get the 5x bonus or not, because the number might look low, but if it's only a 1x bonus, it's still getting you good points. (3-4 or more is good, 7-8 is awesome for the 1x bonus).
